rationale: CR-001 (the sole prior blocking finding) is resolved: commit bb2f149de swaps the selected-item token in src/components/form/Autocomplete/ptPreset.ts:67 from bg-surface-interactive-active (~1.09:1 against the panel) to bg-surface-specific-dropdown-focused. Current source and tailwind.config.ts confirm that token resolves to neutral['525'] = #888888 in dark theme against the panel's neutral['875'] = #212224 (~4.8:1, clears the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 minimum) -- the same value already used for the proven dropdown-focused state in the sibling Dropdown (src/styles/presets/lara/dropdown/index.ts) and MultiSelect (src/components/form/MultiSelect/ptPreset.ts) presets from EPMCDME-8547. The regression test in DataSourceTypeSelector.test.tsx was updated in the same commit to assert the new class on both first-open and reopen-after-blur. All 1 blocking finding graded within budget; no new findings raised (fix stayed scoped to the token and its test). business_review and standards_review carried forward unchanged from the prior verdict per the check-round contract.
